rule: Earliest publication date between November 2021 and November 2026 inclusive
illustrative_example: A conference paper first published in June 2021 (illustrative, not a recorded decision)
source_in_list: Search log and verification notes; Scope and assessment method

rule: The date used is the earliest publication date in the registry or primary source; DOI registration year is not used
illustrative_example: An article online in December 2021 but in a 2022 issue counts as 2021 (illustrative)

rule: Journal articles, conference papers and substantive book chapters are eligible; reviews and relevant scholarly analyses are allowed
illustrative_example: A journal review of data space architectures (illustrative)

rule: Standalone preprints, data sets, peer-review reports, whole proceedings, front matter and retractions are not selected
illustrative_example: A proceedings front-matter record returned by a title search (illustrative)

rule: Clearly unrelated records are not selected
illustrative_example: A record on outer-space data from a 'data space' title search (illustrative)

rule: Retain for direct relevance to the research question or a clear enabling mechanism; for RQ2 and RQ5, enabling mechanisms from adjacent domains are allowed but do not establish deployment in data spaces
illustrative_example: A federated-learning privacy paper outside data spaces, kept under RQ5 as an enabling mechanism (illustrative)

rule: Within each question DOI duplicates are removed and alternative versions of one study are not selected twice
illustrative_example: A conference paper and its extended journal version: one is selected (illustrative)

rule: At most 50 placements per research question; lower-priority relevant records are not selected once the cap is reached
illustrative_example: A relevant record ranked below the 50 retained for RQ3 (illustrative)

rule: Official legislation, standards and the bachelor thesis are contextual primary sources and are excluded from the scholarly counts
decision: exclude from counts; may be cited
source_in_list: PRISMA style selection counts; Official regulations and standards companion

rule: Peer-review completion was not verified individually for every publication
